profile.headline: Appian Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Catering, Microsoft Word, Java, Teamwork, and Leadership. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science from George Mason University.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · On-site

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Appian Developer for the Department of Labor, solely built four separate Appian applications that were integrated with Power BI. Manage the import, export and maintenance of all the environments. Set up integration with Power BI, React, and Azure DB. Design a DB integration with Azure Snaps non SQL DB. Set up SAML with single sign on for Microsoft Azure.
Trained people that were never exposed to Appian in the past and eventually got them to earn a Level 2 certification. Designed and enforced procedures for development that ensure that developers could work together as a team on a shared platform. These procedures guarantee no mistakes were made and will be beneficial for future projects.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Engineering · Software Development · Back-End Web Development · jQuery · Servers · Technical Support · HTML5 · Low-Code Development · Troubleshooting · Programming · Data Management · IT Integration

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Appian Developer for the National Institute of Health, worked alongside a team of nine developers. Created Appian solution for NIH so that the hiring of contractors through third-party vendors can be streamlined. Mr. Gutierrez was responsible for requirement gathering, Appian configuration, resolving defects from historic data, and deployments.
Worked alongside a very non-technical client and found a solution to the NIMH processes for hiring third party contractors. Collecting top-level requirements from NIH stakeholders, account the needs of customers, third party users, and the internal stakeholders. Build User stories, Feature descriptions, story points on JIRA system.
positions.insights: Skills: Application Engineering · API Development · Software Development · Back-End Web Development · Servers · Low-Code Development · Android Development · Troubleshooting · Programming · Data Management · IT Integration

positions.title: Appian Developer
positions.description:
Mr. Gutierrez worked on an FDA project overlooking Production Support and creating enhancements to the system. He provided support to tickets on a daily basis with 5 levels of severity, where levels can range from 2 weeks of development to immediate action to be fixed in less than an hour. He also developed new features to the application under CCR tickets.
System Administrator for local Appian Server, where responsibilities included upgrading Appian engines and modules, enhancements of Web Services calls, customization of Appian plug-ins and replacement of deprecated tools.
Mr. Gutierrez worked for two separate branches of DOL: SCSEP and ETA. He wrote different Appian applications that co-exist with a larger entity platform. He helped design Java and SOA Web Services by using Spring FrameWork that will save data on a PL/SQL Oracle Database warehouse.
